tooling.message:
test: skip the no-browser test in the pre-push hook, on purpose

## Intent

The pre-push hook failed on a test the push did not touch: "where no browser can start, the app could not be checked" starts and refuses Playwright's browser, which takes longer than its 5 seconds while the whole suite runs in parallel. Pushes should not fail on it; CI keeps running it.

## Key changes

- The pre-push hook sets LERNAPPS_PRE_PUSH=1.
- That one test skips itself when the variable is set, with a comment on why. The other tests of the file run as before.
- CI and every other run play the test.
